chunks: And by his chain, from Ibn Mahboub, from Rabi' al-Asam, from Abu Ubayda al-Hazza', and Malik ibn Atiyya, from Abu al-Ward, both of them, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

When a man divorces his wife with a single divorce during his illness, then she remains in his illness until her waiting period expires, then she inherits him as long as she has not remarried. And if she remarries after the expiration of the waiting period, then she does not inherit him.

key_terms.مَرَضِهِ: his illness (specifically terminal illness in this context)

ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit from her husband if he divorces her during his final illness and she remarries before he dies?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the application of the 'deathbed divorce' (taliq al-marid) rule, emphasizing that the single divorce does not become final until the waiting period (iddah) concludes while the husband remains in his illness. It establishes that remarriage during this specific window severs the inheritance link, a nuance critical in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between temporary separation and permanent dissolution of marital ties. The ruling underscores the protective intent of preserving the wife's financial rights unless she voluntarily enters a new marriage contract.

en.hubeali:
And by his chain, from Ibn Mahboub, from Rabi’e Al Asam, from Abu Ubeyda Al Haza’a, and Maalik Bin Atiyya, from Abu Al Warad, both of them, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the man divorces his wife with a divorce during his illness, then he remains in his illness until she has fulfilled her waiting period, so she would inherit him for as long as she has not re-married. So if she re-marries after the fulfillment of the waiting period, so she would not inherit him’.
en.sarwar: 2. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated from ibn Mahbub from Rabi’ al-Asamm from abu ‘ Ubaydah al-Hadhdha’ and Malik ibn ‘ Atiyyah from abu al-Ward who both have said the following: “

About the case of a man who divorces his wife once during his illness and waits until her waiting period ends she inherits him as long as she does not marry; but if she marries after her waiting period she then does not inherit his legacy.’”
